name: Cassie
summary: A pair of powered bird-like legs with no upper body, spun out of Oregon State University's ATRIAS research and sold by Agility Robotics to locomotion labs. Cassie became a standard benchmark for reinforcement-learning gait control — a Cassie set a Guinness record for the fastest 100 m by a bipedal robot in 2022 — and its legs are the foundation of Digit.
notable: Guinness record: fastest 100 m by a bipedal robot (2022)
